Quandoquidem regis mandato imperetur collegio justitiae, ut tempore tam importuno judicia exercerent, declarare se, omnes sententias in foro illo ferendas hoc tempore nullas esse, cum ex legum praescripto quadraginta dierum citatio praecederet; quod tempus observari nequit: neque subditis causas in hoc foro acturis vacare possit, scripta & causarum documenta quae in locis tutioribus in motuum horum fervore reposuerunt custodienda deprome-re; cum privatis & domesticis suis negotiis aliquantisper consulere cogantur, quae praeparationibus ad religionem & patriam suam defenden-dam distenti, mensibus hisce elapsis prorsus neglexerunt.

head.i: Historica narratio Synodi Nationalis Edinburgi coactæ.

main_text.p: EX praescripto edicti regii Edinburgum convenerunt ecclesiarum deputati ad synodum Nationalem, quae 12. Augusti aperta fuit: Ubi pro recepta consuetudine proximae synodi praeses, ad Deum precibus & oratione ad synodum, sessionem primam auspicatus est: omnesque monuit, ut literas fidei scribae traderent; quo facto sessio illa dimissa fuit.

page.notes: Printed text is clear throughout. Doubtful readings: "indictionis" (the "n" in the scan is partly overprinted by the "ndic" ligature area; read as indictionis); "defenden-dam" at the line break (the first syllable is hard to read; read as defenden-); "maximique" in the italic passage. The long s in "registris", "sereniss." and "praeses" has been normalised to s. The "4." and "12." are printed inline in the text and are kept there, not as separate paragraphs. The running head is read as IN REGNO SCOTIÆ. 1639.; the year may be considered part of the page header. The ornaments (asterisks and bullets) are not printed text and are left out.
